desc: Ideation complete: selected perimeter-coordinate reduction plus binary search and greedy circular packing.
Implement a helper that converts each boundary point `(x, y)` to a unique clockwise perimeter coordinate in `[0, 4*side)` and sorts all coordinates.
Implement `feasible(d)` for circular spacing: duplicate sorted coordinates, greedily select up to `k` points from each original start, and verify the final wrap-around gap is at least `d`.
Optimize `feasible(d)` using precomputed next-jump indices, two pointers, or binary search jumps to keep the check near `O(n*k)` or `O(n*k*log n)`.
Integrate binary search over `[0, side]` inside `maxDistance` and return the maximum feasible distance.
Run sample tests and edge-case tests for corners, clustered points, `k == len(points)`, large `side`, and small distances; fix any failures.
